why_ai: Editing, colour, VFX and sound happen on screens with no licence, protected by the colorist and editor relationships clients follow, while roto, cleanup, conform and captions are being automated.
why_clarity: Platform delivery specs are exact and checkable, but the cut, the grade and the mix are judged by the client's taste over revision rounds.
why_digital: Footage files in, digital masters out, with supervised sessions and stage bookings keeping buying partly local.

why_ai: Supervisors' judgement and studio trust protect the hero work, while prep, roto and cleanup are absorbed by segmentation and generative tools.
why_clarity: Shots are bid against breakdowns and approved version by version, but approval is creative and effort varies widely within a category.
why_digital: Plates in, rendered shots out, with work moved between countries for incentives.

why_ai: Studios award year-long packages on trusted supervisors and capacity for novel creature, FX and environment work, and demand for spectacle is not falling.
why_clarity: Each tentpole is a one-off creative build judged by directors over a year, with cost known only at wrap.
why_digital: Entirely pipeline work, awarded and delivered across continents.

why_ai: Screen replacements, paint-outs and sky swaps are exactly what machine-learning roto, paint and generative fill now do.
why_clarity: Invisible effects have a clear standard (the viewer must not notice), recur by the hundred per episode and are approved within days.
why_digital: Plates in and shots out on a weekly cadence, often with prep offshore.

why_ai: Cinematographers and showrunners follow specific colorists, and the supervised grading session in a calibrated suite is the product, though conform and shot matching automate.
why_clarity: Masters must pass exact HDR specs, but the look is a creative decision agreed in the room.
why_digital: Camera originals in and masters out on screen, with supervised sessions keeping buying tied to a few hubs.

why_ai: Physical reels are inspected and repaired by hand on a bench, and telling grain from dirt on a damaged element is an expert call, while digital clean-up keeps automating.
why_clarity: A remastered title has a defined target, but each element's damage is different and methods vary by lab.
why_digital: Starts from physical film shipped to a lab and ends as a digital master.

why_ai: Parsing schedules, drafting cue sheets and checking documents against contracts is document work language and audio models already do.
why_clarity: Every item on a delivery schedule is checkable and recurs show after show, though distributors return items weeks later.
why_digital: Documents and files in and out, handled remotely.

why_ai: Independent filmmakers choose post partners they trust to guide them through specs they don't know, though deliverables work automates.
why_clarity: Every indie film is a one-off with its own budget, schedule and distributor requirements.
why_digital: Cut files in, digital packages out, with filmmakers buying through festival-circuit relationships.

why_ai: Producers hire the supervisor for vendor relationships and judgement under deadline, and juggling six vendors through recuts is novel each show.
why_clarity: The delivery date is clear, but how to run a show's post differs by supervisor and outcomes appear only at delivery.
why_digital: Status reports, schedules and calls on screen, with supervisors hired through local production networks.

why_ai: Packaging and inspecting masters against written specs is rule-based work that automated QC and orchestration already do most of.
why_clarity: A written spec, a check and a platform inspection that passes or fails within hours.
why_digital: Masters in, packages out, uploaded to platforms.

why_ai: Speech recognition drafts captions directly and keeps absorbing review, timing and placement.
why_clarity: Timed-text specs and FCC quality rules define a correct file, repeated for every programme hour.
why_digital: Programme audio in, caption files out, produced anywhere.

why_ai: Project tracking from trade sources and calls is compilation work that scraping and language models already do much of.
why_clarity: Project records follow a defined schema and are updated daily, though accuracy is checked only when a project moves.
why_digital: Public and phoned-in information compiled and sold as an online database.

why_ai: Rule-based QC software whose spec maintenance and triage are themselves automatable.
why_clarity: Templates implement written specs and every run passes or fails.
why_digital: Software licensed and run on files, on premises or in the cloud.

why_ai: Awarding nine-figure VFX budgets and negotiating with vendors rests on studio executives' judgement and relationships.
why_clarity: Bids are compared on a common breakdown, but whether the right vendor won shows only at delivery.
why_digital: Bids and cost reports analysed on screen, with vendor relationships managed in person and by call.

why_ai: A statutory body must issue the certificate, though checking applications against rules automates.
why_clarity: Eligibility rules and expenditure tests are written in statute and applied case by case at volume.
why_digital: Applications and audited accounts submitted and certified online.

why_ai: Spec writing and inspection tooling automate, while deciding what platforms will require stays a platform judgement.
why_clarity: Specs are written rules and inspection gives fast pass or fail on every delivery.
why_digital: Specs, tools and inspections run entirely in software.

why_ai: Product and market research inside software vendors is screen work that AI tools increasingly assist and AI-native entrants compete with.
why_clarity: Roadmap research follows familiar methods but outcomes show over release cycles.
why_digital: Software built, sold and supported online.

why_ai: Acquisition and integration decisions in a contracting market are judgement-heavy and relationship-led.
why_clarity: Each deal and integration is different and its outcome shows years later.
why_digital: Financials and facility data analysed on screen, deals done in person.

why_ai: Per-frame roto and paint is the VFX work segmentation models substitute most directly.
why_clarity: Defined shapes and cleanups at enormous volume with quick client acceptance.
why_digital: Frames in, frames out, routinely offshore.

why_ai: Accredited assessors visit sites and judge controls, and AI-era leaks raise the stakes on content security.
why_clarity: Assessments follow a published best-practice framework repeated across vendors.
why_digital: Questionnaires online plus on-site assessment of physical facilities.

why_ai: Standards carry authority from consensus among the industry's engineers, which software does not replace.
why_clarity: Standards are precise documents, but each is a one-off negotiation whose adoption shows years later.
why_digital: Drafted, balloted and published online by global committees.

why_ai: Membership, bargaining and community events depend on people and relationships.
why_clarity: Annual events and surveys repeat, but their value is hard to measure.
why_digital: Member services split between in-person events and online content.

why_ai: Rules and enforcement require a federal agency's legal authority, though complaint triage automates.
why_clarity: Written quality standards applied to complaints case by case.
why_digital: Complaints, rules and dispositions handled online.

why_ai: Search and matching automate, while judging which names and references create claim risk keeps a researcher and counsel involved.
why_clarity: Clearance reports follow a standard method, but whether a claim was avoided is known only if one arrives.
why_digital: Scripts and cuts researched against databases and delivered as reports remotely.

why_ai: Lending against studio receivables and incentive claims needs accountable credit officers and borrower relationships.
why_clarity: Credit processes are codified, but loss outcomes appear over the life of the facility.
why_digital: Financials reviewed on screen, with relationships held in person.
